title: Anthropic merges Claude chat and Cowork in one interface | TechCrunch
summary: The unified interface lets users access chat, Cowork, and Artifacts (Claude’s interactive workspace feature) within one window. Claude Design, which was introduced in April for website and prototype design, also works anywhere within Claude.
